target.statement: GPT-4V achieves an average ASD of 25.32 across the five safety dimensions on the English subset of MLLMGuard.

compute.basis: Requires running GPT-4V (closed-source API) on 1,500 samples and training GuardRank evaluators (LLaMA-2 7B with LoRA and RoBERTa-large) on human-annotated data, which is not publicly released.

blockers: GPT-4V is a closed-source model accessible only via API, not runnable locally.
Human-annotated training data for GuardRank is not publicly available.
Training GuardRank requires a GPU with at least 24GB VRAM (e.g., RTX 3090/4090).
The full dataset (2,282 samples) is not fully public; only 1,500 samples are released, and non-anonymized data requires an application.
title: MLLMGuard: A Multi-dimensional Safety Evaluation Suite for Multimodal Large Language Models
